verdict: Most of ruling 38 holds under a fresh sweep. Wall clicks are clean on both maps for every collision radius. There is no per-tick side dither. Determinism holds. Every movement-sensitive soak gate passes. The fix is still not proven in the sim, and it fails on the owner's 'runs around on its own' / 'stops short' half wherever the hero is among its OWN standing wave. Ruling 38 claims 0 moves ended > 0.5 m short of an uncrowded point (and 0 held moves > 2 m short in packed fights). This sweep found a single click on BRIDGE that ended 7.28 m short of an open, uncrowded point with a 1.17x lane: the hero was inside a standing ally wave, no lane was ever planned, and the move gave up after 2 s. It also found a held button boxed in by an ally wave sieging a BRIDGE tower that stood the hero motionless for the full 9 s, 9.19 m short. Give-up then retry ran every ~2 s, so a player holding the button sees a frozen hero. After 8:00 with live enemy fighters, 3 BRIDGE held moves of 384 reversed 3-5 times (>= 0.5 m legs, the live HOLD-DITHER signature). The worst walked 1.2 m away from its point for 1.5 s on a relaxed 'stuck' lane before coming round. The repo's own new probe_sim_hold_tower.ts (ruling 39, written against the live repro) fails its 'allies' case on the real RIFT map: the hero cannot walk through its own standing Wicks (5.57 s, 15.3 m path), and passing Wicks shove it 2.90 m. That corroborates the ally-wave class independently. Picking is much better but not the '0 wrong' ruling 38 states: 216 of 3.21 M occlusion-sweep clicks (0.0067 %) and 15 of 217 k clump clicks went to the wrong body, all near silhouette edges toward the screen corners. Combined with the live lens's open HOLD-DITHER blocker (verify_controls_live.json), pass = false.

majors.scenario: waves sampler, single right-click (no hold), vashil seed 3 tick 2035 (~1:08 after the 35 s warm-up)
majors.observed: The hero started inside a standing ALLY wave (11 team-0 Wicks within 1.5 m). No lane was planned at any tick (lane 0, lanePlanned false). When the wave started marching the same way (v 3.25), those Wicks no longer counted as 'in the way', but they still body-blocked. Two no-progress windows ended the move cleanly 7.3 m short. Ruling 38 claims 0 such moves on this sampler shape (14 / 19 before, 0 / 0 after).
majors.caveat: The sampler teleports the hero 1.5-5.5 m behind a random minion, so the start slightly overlaps a Wick. A player can walk into the same pocket, and probe_sim_hold_tower 'allies' reproduces the class on the real map without teleporting.

majors.scenario: held-button sweep (the same point re-sent every 15 ticks while > 2 m short, 9 s), ardit seed 7 move 7, t 289 s, 7.5 m from a tower
majors.observed: Ten ally Wicks were standing (v 0) round the hero while they sieged the tower. The hero did not move for 255 ticks. The watchdog behaved per spec: two windows with no lane, the move ended, and the held re-send restarted it about every 2 s. Without the re-send, the move ends at ~2.6 s. Ally Wicks that are attacking never yield to their own hero, so a held button gives a frozen hero for as long as the wave stands. To a player this reads as 'the click does nothing'.

majors.scenario: held-button sweep after 8:00 with bot fighters in every other seat (HELD_BOTS=1 HELD_T0=480), 384 moves
majors.observed: hesmi s19 k9 (t 551 s): an enemy fighter's dash knocked the hero back (cc 64). After a no-progress window, the relaxed stuck lane (up to 2 m back) walked it 1.2 m AWAY from its point for ~1.5 s (d 6.6 -> 7.8 m). It then re-planned to the other side (side -1 -> +1) and arrived at 5.6 s. The move did arrive, but the back-and-forth is the shape the owner calls 'runs around on its own'. majors.caveat: Part of the reversal count is enemy displacement (expected). The 1.5 s walk away from the point is movement code.

fix_direction: Treat the hero's own Wicks as passable or yielding. Either the hero walks through allied Wicks the way the ruling 39 probe expects, or a standing or attacking ally Wick in a walking hero's lane steps aside (a soft yield like the idle one). Bound the stuck lane's backing to a short, visible sidestep, not a 1.2 m walk away. Make the pick box's top 4 px and its body half-width follow the true perspective silhouette near the screen corners.
